endpoints.summary: Run the full LightDock docking protocol; returns ranked docked complexes.
endpoints.description: Run the full LightDock docking protocol; returns ranked docked complexes.

request_fields.name: swarms
request_fields.description: Number of GSO swarms. 0 = auto-estimate from the receptor surface (can be hundreds — use with care on FC). Set a small value for interactive runs.

request_fields.name: glowworms
request_fields.description: Number of glowworms (candidate poses) per swarm.

request_fields.name: steps
request_fields.description: Number of GSO optimization steps.

request_fields.name: scoring_function
request_fields.description: LightDock scoring function (e.g. fastdfire, dfire, cpydock, pisa, vdw, dna for protein-DNA). Validated against the installed set; see /healthz/detail for the available list.

request_fields.name: cores
request_fields.description: Multiprocessing cores for the GSO run. None → service default.

request_fields.name: top
request_fields.description: Number of top-ranked docked complexes to generate (top/top_N.pdb).

request_fields.name: swarm_seed
request_fields.description: Random seed for starting-position (swarm) calculation.

request_fields.name: gso_seed
request_fields.description: Random seed for the GSO algorithm.

request_fields.name: use_anm
request_fields.description: Enable ANM backbone flexibility during setup + conformation generation.

request_fields.name: cluster_cutoff
request_fields.description: Backbone-RMSD cutoff (A) for per-swarm BSAS clustering.

request_fields.name: noxt
request_fields.description: Remove OXT atoms during setup.

request_fields.name: noh
request_fields.description: Remove hydrogen atoms during setup.

request_fields.name: now
request_fields.description: Remove water (H2O) during setup.

examples.title: quick interactive protein-protein docking (small sampling)
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/dock -F receptor=@receptor.pdb -F ligand=@ligand.pdb -F swarms=20 -F glowworms=100 -F steps=50 -F top=10
examples.notes: Ranked poses land in output/top/top_1.pdb .. top_10.pdb. Keep swarms small for interactive latency.

examples.title: restraint-driven docking
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/dock -F receptor=@receptor.pdb -F ligand=@ligand.pdb -F restraints=@restraints.list -F swarms=20 -F steps=100
examples.notes: restraints.list focuses swarms near the specified interface residues.

examples.title: protein-DNA docking
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/dock -F receptor=@protein.pdb -F ligand=@dna.pdb -F scoring_function=dna -F swarms=20
examples.notes: Use the `dna` scoring function for protein-nucleic-acid complexes.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.dock: output/top/top_<n>.pdb — ranked docked complexes (receptor + ligand), top_1 = best score. output/rank_by_scoring.list — global ranking table. output/setup.json — resolved LightDock config (swarm count, ANM, seeds).
tool_outputs.note: Use GET /api/jobs/{id}/files to enumerate; download a single file via /api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath} or zip the whole dir via /download.

input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a file from a prior job on the shared NAS.
input_uri_schemes.file:///abs/path: Direct NAS path; works across services on the shared mount.
input_uri_schemes.oss://<bucket>/<key>: Alibaba Cloud OSS object (needs OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / _SECRET env vars).
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

config_tips.runtime: Cost scales with swarms x glowworms x steps. The upstream production preset (400 swarms, 200 glowworms, 100 steps) takes hours. For interactive runs set a small `swarms` (10-40) and supply `restraints` to focus sampling.
config_tips.swarms: 0 = auto-estimate from the receptor surface (can be hundreds). Set explicitly to bound runtime.
config_tips.restraints: LightDock restraints file: lines like `R A.35` (receptor active) or `L B.10` (ligand). Focuses swarms near known interface residues.
config_tips.scoring_function: fastdfire (default, fast DFIRE) suits most protein-protein cases; `dna` for protein-DNA; `cpydock` (pyDock energy) and `pisa` are alternatives. See /healthz/detail for the installed set.
config_tips.use_anm: Enable ANM backbone flexibility to sample conformational changes (slower). Off by default (rigid-body).

endpoints_summary./api/dock: Full LightDock GSO docking protocol (setup -> run -> conformations -> cluster -> rank -> top); output/top/top_N.pdb.
